abstract: The effects of beta-mercaptoethanol (ME) on the steady-state level of mRNA of the human chorionic gonadotropin-beta subunit (hCG-beta) and the intracellular hormonal dynamics of the product protein were examined in BeWo cells, a choriocarcinoma cell line, using Northern blot analysis and a radioimmunoassay (RIA) specific for hCG-beta. ME reduced both medium and intracellular contents of hCG-beta in a dose-dependent manner, with its minimum effective dose being 0.01 per cent. The highest dose used (0.1 per cent) caused more than 90 per cent inhibition with both parameters, without affecting the cell number and the cell viability as verified by trypan blue exclusion. Significant reductions in both the medium and intracellular contents began to occur 6 h after the onset of incubation with ME. The ME-induced suppressions were reversible. Northern blot analysis showed that ME had no effects on the steady-state level of hCG-beta mRNA. When medium and cell lysates collected from ME-free incubations were incubated with 0.03 per cent ME, there were significant reductions of immunoreactive hCG-beta with both the medium and cell lysates. The magnitude of reduction, however, was much greater with the latter (75 per cent) than with the former (25 per cent). In contrast, the hCG-beta immunoreactivity of the RIA reference preparation was unaffected by incubation with ME. These results suggested that the major target(s) of ME action were the intracellularly located hCG-beta molecule, presumably its intramolecular disulphide bonds. It must also be pointed out that the hCG-beta molecule synthesized and secreted by BeWo cells have some structural deviation from the reference standard molecule of normal trophoblastic origin to explain the differential susceptibility to ME.
abstract_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞において、β-メルカプトエタノール(ME)がヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)βサブユニット(hCG-β)のmRNA定常状態レベルおよび産物蛋白の細胞内ホルモン動態に及ぼす影響を、ノーザンブロット解析とhCG-β特異的ラジオイムノアッセイ(RIA)を用いて検討した。MEは培地中および細胞内のhCG-β含量を用量依存的に低下させ、最小有効量は0.01%であった。最大用量の0.1%では、細胞数と細胞生存に影響を与えることなく、両パラメータを90%以上抑制した。培地と細胞内の含量の有意な低下は、MEを添加して6時間後に生じ始めた。MEによる抑制は可逆的であった。ノーザンブロット解析では、MEはhCG-β mRNAの定常状態レベルに影響を及ぼさなかった。MEを含まない条件で採取した培地および細胞溶解液に0.03%MEを加えたところ、免疫反応性hCG-βは有意に低下したが、低下の程度は細胞溶解液(75%)の方が培地(25%)より大きかった。一方、RIAの参照標品のhCG-β免疫反応性はMEによる影響を受けなかった。これらの結果から、MEの主な作用標的は細胞内に存在するhCG-β分子、すなわちその分子内ジスルフィド結合であると考えられた。さらに、BeWo細胞が合成・分泌するhCG-β分子は、正常な栄養膜由来の参照標準分子と構造上のずれがあり、それがMEに対する感受性の差を説明すると考えられる。
